outcome: Haemodynamic effects (systolic blood pressure, diastolic blood pressure)
cohort: The study included 80 women undergoing elective caesarean section with normal antenatal care, divided into two groups of 40.
finding: The administration of a solitary dose of carbetocin demonstrated a safer hemodynamic profile and reduced requirement for uterotonics compared to oxytocin.
mod_finding: For women undergoing elective caesarean section, carbetocin demonstrated a safer hemodynamic profile and reduced requirement for uterotonics compared to oxytocin.
